description: Successor of disc-0013. The agent-facing text file has an exact byte layout at 1.1: the H1 first, the blockquote summary straight after it as llms.txt v2 orders them, then the provenance comment, then the cluster sections ordered by slug and an Other section for unclustered items, one blank line between blocks and nothing else; a draft item appears nowhere; an item with no description repeats its title. In a link line the backslash, `[`, `]` and `(` of the title and of the description are each preceded by one backslash, the backslash first, and no other character is escaped: the item odd-title has the title `Odd [title] (v2)\` and the description `See [the guide](x) and a \ backslash.`, which become `Odd \[title\] \(v2)\\` and `See \[the guide\]\(x) and a \\ backslash.` (`)` is not escaped). The provenance header carries the line bundle_version between spec_version and generated_at on a node that is not restricted. Expected bytes are derived by hand from AGSC-06-13a.
